name: derived-view

rubric.criterion: Distinguishes the writable board contents from the immutable derived snapshot. Any restructuring preserves one authority for transition acceptance and both update entry points.
Explains snapshot identity, historical immutability and notification ordering with code evidence; does not count cached derived data itself as competing authority.

Shows an actual resulting API and change path. Keeping the class, extracting private batch calculation, or introducing a bounded owner can all pass when their total contract and glue cost are justified.

false_positives: Removing or rejecting the cached immutable snapshot solely because it duplicates item data.
Demanding a separate manager for every operation even though both change one board.

source.purpose: Portable adversarial case derived from module-boundary research; not copied from a production checkout.
